# ChoiKraus.ChoiKrausChar

**Choi–Kraus 表征**

对任意有限维复线性映射完整建立 CP↔Choi PSD↔至多 D·E 项 Kraus 表示、给定 Kraus 表示下 TP↔完备式、以及 CP∧TP↔存在完备 Kraus 表示，并保留零维边界与 QuantumChannel 存在性。

**边界**：只做 Choi/Kraus 表征与 Physlib 约定桥；不把 Kraus 存在性作为输入，也不覆盖测量扩张、仪器复合或信道距离与资源费用。

**覆盖等级**：A

| `Qatlib.Concepts.ChoiKraus.ChoiKrausChar.cp_tp_iff_complete_kraus` | theorem | L45 | A map is completely positive and trace preserving exactly when it admits a complete Kraus family of size at most `D * E`; see [Choi, completely positive linear maps][Choi1975] and [Kraus1971]. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.ChoiKraus.ChoiKrausChar.choiKrausCorrected` | theorem | L60 | Complete positivity is equivalent to Choi positivity and to a Kraus representation with at most `D * E` terms, while trace preservation is equivalent to completeness of any given Kraus representation [Choi1975]. |
